subtitle: On the frontier of Bactria, a pale metal binds worlds together

panels.shot: epic close-up of a pale, gleaming coin held between fingers against a blurred map from Bactria toward India and China
panels.action: Agathocles & Pantaleon of Bactria stand in shadowed profile behind an enlarged pale coin, while a faint map of the Oxus, Punjab and far eastern mountains stretches behind them.

dialogue.text: In Bactria’s markets, Agathocles and Pantaleon struck coins of strange pale metal, hinting that knowledge travelled where no army ever marched.

i18n.hi: बैक्ट्रिया के बाज़ारों में अगाथोक्लेस और पैंटालियन ने अजीब फीके धातु के सिक्के ढाले — साबित कि ज्ञान वहाँ पहुँचा जहाँ फ़ौजें नहीं

panels.shot: broad aerial view following the Oxus river through mountains and plains
panels.action: The Oxus river winds silver through a vast landscape of snow peaks, desert and orchards, tiny caravans threading along its banks.

dialogue.text: Here, along the Oxus, Greek kings ruled far from Greece, in a land of Persian roads, Indian winds and caravans whispering of China.

i18n.hi: यहीं ओक्सस किनारे, यूनानी बादशाह यूनान से दूर राज करते थे — फ़ारसी राहें, भारतीय हवाएँ, और चीन की फ़ुसफ़ुस करती काफ़िले

panels.shot: low-angle interior wide of a Bactrian palace hall with Greek columns and Central Asian motifs
panels.action: Agathocles & Pantaleon stand in a columned hall hung with Greek-style frescoes and steppe motifs, advisers and scribes clustered with tablets and coin dies.

dialogue.text: Agathocles and Pantaleon, heirs of the Greco-Bactrian line, balanced on this frontier, ruling cities where Greek boulevards met Asian bazaars.

i18n.hi: अगाथोक्लेस और पैंटालियन, ग्रीको–बैक्ट्रियन वारिस, इसी किनारे पर टिके थे — जहाँ यूनानी सड़कें एशियाई बाज़ारों से मिलतीं

panels.shot: medium shot over a moneyer’s shoulder toward the king examining coins
panels.action: Agathocles & Pantaleon lean over a minting bench, studying small round flans while a craftsman readies a die and hammer nearby.

dialogue.text: Power here flowed not only from spears, but from small round pieces of metal that carried a king’s face and promise.

i18n.hi: यहाँ ताक़त सिर्फ़ भालों से नहीं, उन छोटे गोल सिक्कों से भी बहती थी जिन पर राजा का चेहरा और वादा दोनों छपे थे

panels.shot: macro extreme close-up of three different coins side by side
panels.action: Three enlarged coins rest on dark cloth: one warm yellow gold, one reddish copper, and between them a pale, almost silvery piece with Greco-Bactrian imagery.

dialogue.text: Most coins in their world gleamed gold, silver or copper. Yet some Greco-Bactrian coins shine with a pale, unusual metal.

i18n.hi: उनकी दुनिया के ज़्यादातर सिक्के सोने, चाँदी या ताँबे में चमकते थे, फिर भी कुछ ग्रीको–बैक्ट्रियन सिक्कों में फीका, अनोखा धातु झिलमिलाता है

panels.shot: diagrammatic oblique shot of a cut coin revealing internal metal texture
panels.action: An enlarged cross-section of a coin shows mixed metallic grains, with a subtle contrast between coppery and whitish phases, set against a simple workshop backdrop.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars cut and test these coins. They find an alloy of copper and nickel—cupro-nickel—rare in the ancient world.

i18n.hi: आधुनिक विद्वान इन सिक्कों को काटकर जाँचते हैं — ताँबे–निकेल की मिश्र धातु मिलती है, कपरो–निकल, जो प्राचीन दुनिया में लगभग नामालूम थी

panels.shot: split-screen style: Bactrian mint on one side, early Chinese workshop on the other
panels.action: On the left, a Bactrian mint with Greek tools and Central Asian workers; on the right, a Chinese-smelting scene with furnaces and ingots, both linked by a faint caravan route line.

dialogue.text: In early China, craftsmen already knew a pale alloy called white copper. In Bactria, such metal appears only in a few royal issues.

i18n.hi: चीन में कारीगर काफ़ी पहले से उजला ‘सफ़ेद ताँबा’ जानते थे, पर बैक्ट्रिया में यह धातु बस गिने–चुने शाही सिक्कों में दिखती है

panels.shot: wide shot of a bustling Bactrian market with diverse traders
panels.action: A crowded marketplace shows Greeks, Central Asian nomads, Indians and eastern-looking traders bargaining among textiles, spices, metal ingots and horses.

dialogue.text: Between these worlds, caravans moved jade, horses, silk, spices—and sometimes, new ways of shaping metal.

i18n.hi: इन दो दुनियाओं के बीच काफ़िले जेड, घोड़े, रेशम, मसाले लाते–ले जाते थे — और कभी–कभी धातु ढालने के नए ढंग भी

panels.shot: mid shot of a merchant displaying a pale metal ingot to a Bactrian metallurgist
panels.action: A weathered trader unwraps a small pale ingot, while a Bactrian metalworker in a soot-stained apron examines its sheen in the lamplight.

dialogue.text: We do not see the meeting in any text, but the coins suggest a moment when unfamiliar metal reached a curious Bactrian hand.

i18n.hi: काग़ज़ कहीं नहीं, पर इन सिक्कों से लगता है किसी रोज़ अजनबी धातु पहली बार किसी जिज्ञासु बैक्ट्रियाई के हाथ में उतरी

panels.shot: intimate workshop close-up as the king observes a test casting
panels.action: Agathocles & Pantaleon watch intently as a craftsman pours glowing metal from a crucible into shallow coin moulds on a stone bench.

dialogue.speaker: agathocles_and_pantaleon
dialogue.text: Strike it, weigh it. Let us see if this pale metal can carry a king’s promise.

i18n.hi: इसे पीटो, तौलो — देखो क्या यह फीका धातु भी राजा का वादा ढो सकता है

panels.shot: low-angle shot of a hammer striking a die over a pale blank
panels.action: A hammer descends toward a die set on a pale metal blank, the craftsman’s muscles tense, the moment frozen just before impact.

dialogue.text: In those mints, under hammers and dies, experiments became money, and money became a message that travelled farther than any herald.

i18n.hi: उन टकसालों में, हथौड़े और साँचे के नीचे, प्रयोग पैसे बने, और पैसा बन गया वो पैग़ाम जो हर सिपहबख़र से दूर तक गया

panels.shot: close-up of two specific cupro-nickel coins labelled by portrait style (visually, not textually)
panels.action: Two enlarged coins lie side by side: one with the youthful profile of Euthydemus II, another with a Greco-Bactrian ruler, both in the distinct pale alloy.

dialogue.text: Numismatists today group these pale issues under names like Euthydemus II, Agathocles and Pantaleon, reading kings from portraits and legends.

i18n.hi: आज के नूमिस्मैटिस्ट इन फीके सिक्कों को इयूथीडेमस द्वितीय, अगाथोक्लेस और पैंटालियन जैसी श्रेणियों में रखते हैं, चेहरों और लेख से राजा पहचानते हैं

panels.shot: map shot showing Bactria connected by arrows toward India and toward the Tarim and China
panels.action: A simple, stylised map shows Bactria with arrows of trade and influence stretching southeast into Gandhara and northwest and eastward toward the Tarim and China.

dialogue.text: Though Agathocles and Pantaleon ruled mainly in Bactria, their coin art and standards touched the same network that linked Gandhara, India and lands further east.

i18n.hi: अगाथोक्लेस और पैंटालियन भले ज़्यादातर बैक्ट्रिया में राज करते रहे, पर उनके सिक्कों की कला और क़ायदे उसी जाल तक गए जो गांधार, भारत और आगे पूरब को जोड़ता था

panels.shot: wide shot of Zhang Qian observing a Central Asian market, with focus on foreign goods
panels.action: An east-Asian envoy identified as Zhang Qian stands in a Central Asian bazaar, watching traders display foreign textiles, metalware and animals.

dialogue.text: Decades later, the Han envoy Zhang Qian reached Central Asia. Sima Qian records his wonder at Bactrian markets rich with goods from many lands.

i18n.hi: कुछ दशक बाद, हान दूत झांग च्यान मध्य एशिया पहुँचा — सिमा च्यान लिखता है कि बैक्ट्रियाई बाज़ारों की रौनक उसे हैरान कर गई

panels.shot: medium shot of modern scholars in a lab examining coins under microscopes
panels.action: Contemporary researchers in a clean laboratory study Greco-Bactrian coins under microscopes and meters, graphs and spectra glowing on nearby screens.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars like Joe Cribb and John Boardman test these coins, weighing theories of Chinese white copper and local nickel-bearing ores.

i18n.hi: आज के विद्वान, जो क्रिब और जॉन बोर्डमैन जैसे, इन सिक्कों को तौलते–परखते हैं, कभी चीन के सफ़ेद ताँबे, कभी स्थानीय निकेल अयस्क की थ्योरी

panels.shot: balanced shot showing two thought-paths represented by branching lines from a single coin
panels.action: From a single enlarged cupro-nickel coin, two branching visual paths emerge: one toward stylised Chinese furnaces, another toward a rocky nickel-rich outcrop.

dialogue.text: The record stays silent on the exact path. Did technique travel from Chinese smelters, or did Bactrian miners chance upon nickel-rich ore on their own?

i18n.hi: रोज़नामचा राह नहीं बताता — क्या हुनर चीनी भट्टियों से आया, या बैक्ट्रियाई खदानों ने खुद किसी निकेल–भरी चट्टान पर ठोकर खाई?

panels.shot: time-lapse style shot with the ancient coin dissolving into modern cupro-nickel coins
panels.action: An ancient pale Greco-Bactrian coin slowly fades into overlapping modern cupro-nickel coins from different countries on a neutral backdrop.

dialogue.text: After these few issues, cupro-nickel almost vanishes from coinage for centuries, then returns in modern times as a standard metal of everyday money.

i18n.hi: इन चंद ढालों के बाद कपरो–निकल सदियों तक सिक्कों से ग़ायब हो जाता है, फिर आधुनिक ज़माने में रोज़मर्रा के पैसों की आम धातु बनकर लौटता है

panels.shot: slow push-in on the king’s reflective face lit by lamplight and coin gleam
panels.action: Agathocles & Pantaleon sit in quiet, one turning a pale coin between his fingers, lamplight catching both his thoughtful eyes and the strange metal.

dialogue.text: Their realms fell, their cities changed hands, yet a few pale coins endure, carrying the memory of a short-lived experiment at the world’s edge.

i18n.hi: उनकी सल्तनतें गिरीं, शहर हाथ बदलते रहे, पर कुछ फीके सिक्के आज भी बचे हैं — दुनिया के किनारे किए गए छोटे से प्रयोग की याद उठाए

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot of caravan silhouettes against twilight, a coin glinting in foreground sand
panels.action: Silhouettes of caravans move along a twilight ridge, while in the foreground sand a single pale coin lies half-buried, catching the last light.

dialogue.text: In that coin, metal, trade and curiosity meet, reminding us that technology often moves quietly, along the same roads as merchants and stories.

i18n.hi: उस सिक्के में धातु, व्यापार और जिज्ञासा मिलते हैं, बताते हुए कि टेक्नोलॉजी अक्सर चुपचाप चलती है, वही राहें चुनकर जिन पर सौदागर और कहानियाँ चलती हैं

title_i18n.en: Cupro Nickel Coin at Worlds Edge

subtitle_i18n.en: On the frontier of Bactria, a pale metal binds worlds together
subtitle_i18n.hi: बैक्ट्रिया की सरहद पर, फीका धातु दो दुनिया जोड़ता है
